limitations: Dedicated code reimplementation, not recovered original code.
Bounce and flock motions are deterministic analytic reconstructions; original simulation trajectories, camera and material shader remain different.
All runtime drawings, textures, refraction code and geometry are independently generated. No full-screen original still or original video is played.
The on-screen original authorship assertion is replicated as reference text, not verified as a fact.
Main serif uses the Windows Times New Roman system font. Portable fallback Instrument Serif has visibly narrower metrics.
